Manually Withdraw a Student

Source: R/manual_class_list_functions.R
withdraw_student_from_school_class.Rd

Marks a student as withdrawn by setting their withdrawal status to `"Y"`. The student is identified using a school identifier supplied through `...`, together with their first name and surname.

Column names are resolved using the package's configurable column-name system.

Usage

withdraw_student_from_school_class(
  data,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  ...,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

first_name

Student's first name (exact, case-sensitive).

last_name

Student's surname (exact, case-sensitive).

...

A named school identifier, such as `URN`, `EST_ID`, or `EST_WONDE_ID`, using the configured column names.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, displays a message confirming the withdrawal.

Value

The updated data frame with the matching student marked as withdrawn. Existing withdrawal statuses are preserved.

If no student or multiple students match, a warning is issued and no changes are made.

Details

School selection uses `.prepare_class_edit()` and `.school_rows()`, consistent with the other manual class-list editing functions.

Student names are matched exactly and are case-sensitive. No Wonde student identifier is required.
